common_cancel.context: Button: leave a dialog without change

common_delete.context: Button / menu item: delete a route point, a route, a tour

common_close.context: Button or content description (accessibility) of an x: close a sheet or dialog

common_back.context: Content description (accessibility) of the back arrow

common_done.context: Button: close a page after finishing

common_not_now.context: Button in a question strip: decline for now

common_retry.context: Button on the map download card after a failed download

common_open.context: Content description of an expand arrow / button: open

common_more.context: Content description (accessibility) of the ⋯ menu button

common_show_all.context: Button: show all items of a list

common_rename.context: Menu item: rename a saved route or tour

common_restore.context: Button: restore from the recycle bin / a backup

common_replace.context: Button: replace the current plan with another route

common_reset.context: Button: back to the default value (settings)

common_cancel_all.context: Button: cancel all waiting map downloads

common_clear_all.context: Button in Offline maps: remove all downloaded map areas
common_clear_all.doubt: 'Alle löschen' – or 'Alle entfernen' (removing maps, not deleting user data)

common_app_settings.context: Button: opens Android's settings page of OnPath (permissions)

common_recycle_bin.context: Title / button: deleted routes and tours that can be restored

common_export_gpx.context: Menu item: save a route or tour as a GPX file
